instruction: Cinematic film still, over-the-shoulder medium shot. In a grassy park, a woman with a large afro (R6) in a red shirt stands in the foreground left with her back to the camera. In the background, a bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt stands holding a framed certificate, smiling towards her. Beside him on the right, a heavy-set man (R1) in a dark blue t-shirt and glasses smiles with his hand on his chest. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene.
